description: Auto-translate selected text and turn it into camelCase, snake_case or CONSTANT_CASE names
engine.race: Request Bing and Tencent at the same time; the first response wins
engine.bing: Bing, falls back to Tencent on failure
engine.tencent: Tencent, falls back to Bing on failure
engine.bilibili: Bilibili (Index-Translate open-source model, free), falls back to Bing on failure
engine.custom: Custom API (translation.customApi), falls back to Bing on failure
bilibiliModel.desc: Model used by the bilibili engine
customApi.desc: Custom translation API. `{text}` (text to translate), `{from}` and `{to}` (language codes) in `url` and `body` are replaced. Only effective in user settings, so a workspace cannot send your selected text to an unknown address.
customApi.resultPath: Dot-separated path to the translation in the response JSON, e.g. data.translations.0.text
customApi.languages: Language code mapping, for APIs that use codes like zh-CN
hover.desc: Show the translation when hovering over a word (master switch; also disables the popup on selection)
styleLowerCamel.desc: Show "lowerCamelCase" (in the popup and the Ctrl+N picker, for multi-word Chinese-to-English results)
styleUpperCamel.desc: Show "UpperCamelCase" (in the popup and the Ctrl+N picker, for multi-word Chinese-to-English results)
styleSnake.desc: Show "snake_case" (in the popup and the Ctrl+N picker, for multi-word Chinese-to-English results)
styleConstant.desc: Show "CONSTANT_CASE" (in the popup and the Ctrl+N picker, for multi-word Chinese-to-English results)
styleOriginal.desc: Show "translation only" (in the popup and the Ctrl+N picker, for multi-word Chinese-to-English results)
selectionHover.desc: Automatically show the translation next to the selected text
selectionHoverDelay.desc: Delay before showing the translation after selecting (ms)
showCopy.desc: Show the "Copy" icon in the popup
showReplace.desc: Show the "Replace" icon in the popup
statusBar.desc: Show the translation of the selected text in the status bar
maxLength.desc: Maximum number of characters to translate; longer text is ignored
cacheSeconds.desc: How long translation results are cached (seconds)
